entry.content:
Celebrating Black Friday for 2018, Lab401 is running a 10% Sale Store Wide.

It's the perfect time to grab one of the new Proxmark RDV4, the hot Keysy 125KHz Duplicator / Emulator. 

Likewise, our RFID Tag Packs and RFID Pen Tester Packs are discounted as well - adding up to over 50% on the Pro packs.

Everything is in stock, and we're excited to get more gear into your hands.
